items.title: Default post reaction trigger distinguishes empty and selected states
items.precondition: Contained runtime is running; signed in; a feed or standalone post has no reaction from the current viewer.
steps: Open the post and inspect its collapsed reaction control.
Confirm it shows a neutral outlined thumb icon and exposes the accessible label React.
Open the picker, choose Heart, then choose Heart again to clear it.
items.expected: The empty state is a neutral icon; the selected Heart sticker appears after selection; clearing returns to the neutral icon without changing the picker or count behavior.
items.evidence: User confirmed the intended empty-state icon and local reaction behavior after testing the local development server in this task.
items.notes: Manual local-server validation supplied by the user.

items.title: Shared default reaction surfaces stay consistent
items.precondition: Contained runtime has a post with a comment/reply and a post with photo actions; each target is unreacted by the viewer.
steps: Open a post detail page and inspect an unreacted comment or reply control.
Open a post photo action row and inspect its unreacted reaction control.
Set, switch, and clear one reaction on each surface.
items.expected: Both use the correctly sized neutral empty icon and preserve their existing reaction endpoint, selected sticker, and summary behavior.
items.evidence: Structural verification: PostCard, CommentItem, and PostMediaGallery all render the same default ReactionBar; no consumer integration code changed.
items.notes: No separate manual comment/photo walkthrough was reported; shared-component wiring confirms the same empty-state branch is used.

items.title: Message reaction toolbar is unchanged
items.precondition: Contained runtime is running; signed in; a message conversation is available.
steps: Open a message toolbar for an unreacted message.
Confirm its existing Smile icon and picker behavior remain intact.
items.expected: No change to message toolbar visuals, labels, or reaction behavior.
items.evidence: Structural verification: MessageBubbleRow explicitly passes variant=toolbar, which continues to render the existing Smile toolbar trigger instead of defaultTriggerContent.
items.notes: No separate manual message-toolbar walkthrough was reported; the toolbar branch is unchanged.
